title: Exploration mission (block 1 input)
description: targets/<id>/01-exploration/missions/M-xxx.yaml: one task the computer-use agent performs on the original software.

goal.description: Plain-language objective, written as the instruction given to the agent.

test_data.description: Fake data only. Never real customer data.

read_values.description: Values the agent must read back on screen (totals, numbers, messages).

network.description: SaaS only: also export a HAR of the session.

ui_steps.description: Concrete UI steps a computer-use agent can execute directly, in order.

target.description: Menu path, button or field label, or window title to act on.

capture.description: For a read step: which on-screen value to record (maps to an expected_values key).

fills.description: What this mission's observed values will complete, so the run can be linked back automatically.

requested_by.description: kickoff, or the unknown U-xxx this mission should answer.
